evidence.observation: Pressure 2.979 Torr at start of growth, near the 2.92 Torr baseline for 100 sccm
Pressure has risen monotonically to 3.249 Torr over the growth stage with no setpoint change
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the rise is not a flow change
Thermocouple tracks 750 °C setpoint with plausible heater power; thermal control normal
Sensor not installed, so leak-derived atmosphere contamination cannot be checked

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 (not installed) or an equivalent test: a pump-down/flow-step or isolation test to distinguish an air in-leak from downstream exhaust restriction.
